purpose: Exercises host-channel request correlation, reserved cleanup admission and recovery after congestion.
behavior: Maps each SpawnFailed code to the matching public error without killing a healthy generation.

Floods 20 trees with 1000 Lists while four concurrent threads each make 25 sequential blocking spawn_on calls (100 Spawn operations total during the flood); reverses List replies and asserts correct per-caller identity.

Fills normal admission, checks cleanup still enters, drains via a marker, then fills all 8192 slots to require generation death; a roughly 950 KB Spawn plus resizes must drain and allow another spawn.
contracts: Assertions target correlation, queue capacity and recovery, not an OS child workload.
dependencies: client/tests/mod.rs provides a controlled protocol peer; client/channel.rs and start.rs are exercised.
failures_or_limits: Artificial peer controls replies; source coverage is not an execution result.

purpose: Checks asynchronous request deadlines and shared failure of concurrent bootstrap callers.
behavior: Silent Stop gets bound plus 200 ms grace and must fail after 1200 ms with Io; silent List and detached Resize expire at 1000 ms.
Five barrier-synchronized callers share one silent Ready attempt; open counter must equal one and elapsed time must be below twice the bound.
contracts: A detached request deadline must wake a waiting tree exit observer and kill the generation.
dependencies: client/start::Registry and client/channel deadline watcher are exercised with test peers.
failures_or_limits: Timing assertions allow bounded scheduling slack but still require complete observations; tests were not run.

purpose: Tests fragmented frames, protocol violations, tree correlation and binary candidate precedence.
behavior: Byte-by-byte Spawned is reconstructed; channel closure halfway through the next frame must yield Io and generation death.
Rejects unsolicited request IDs, wrong reply kind, malformed frame, duplicate Ready, host-only messages, mismatched terminal ends and protocol version.
Rejects another tree ID, duplicate Exited and reused live tree ID; lookup prefers environment then module then executable, treating empty environment as unset.
contracts: Protocol violations fail the waiting operation instead of silently dropping it.
dependencies: channel/route.rs validates frames; start::pick resolves supplied candidate directories.
failures_or_limits: Lookup test uses placeholder files and does not prove executability or launch.

purpose: Verifies exactly one Unix PTY Go outcome and retry after pre-send admission refusal.
behavior: Two callers share one exec-failure reply and later calls return the same NotFound; next frame must be Release, not another Go.
After 1024 resizes deny Go admission, draining replies through a marker permits a later Go and successful Ack.
contracts: A refused unsent Go leaves the terminal root held.
dependencies: client/hold.rs stores the handshake; tests/unix::pty_spawn supplies terminal handles.
failures_or_limits: Uses synthetic supervisor replies, so exec behavior itself is outside these assertions.

purpose: Challenges Unix supervisor termination identities using controlled stand-ins and surviving sentinels.
behavior: Positive control requires a captured identity to SIGKILL its own child; after externally reaping it, a substituted sentinel PID must survive.
Missing pidfd/start time yields Abandoned and the generation error names abandonment.
An orphan that is not this host child must never arm termination; macOS additionally tests a failing exit watch with start-time fallback.
contracts: PID substitution simulates reuse; it does not force actual kernel PID reuse.
dependencies: client/keeper::Ident and Watch implement identity capture and kill.
failures_or_limits: Unix process and signal tests require authorized execution elsewhere; none ran here.

purpose: Runs an isolated resource ledger for Unix startup failures and stuck-supervisor cleanup.
behavior: Ignored inner ledger is launched explicitly by an outer test with one test thread; outer asserts process success and one passed test.
Impossible thread stack and constrained descriptor limit must prevent supervisor creation; repeated oversized, refused and disconnected spawns must restore descriptor counts.
A SIGSTOP stand-in must receive its cooperative window, then be killed by identity and reaped; thread and descriptor totals must return to baseline.
contracts: Incomplete observations fail at LIMIT; macOS also injects a broken exit-watch descriptor.
dependencies: client/unix::start and keeper precreation ordering are exercised.
failures_or_limits: Resource counting requires process isolation and platform facilities; merely reading this file does not establish leak freedom.

purpose: Checks generation lifetime under unknown exits, stalled peers and concurrent waiters.
behavior: Sends 100000 unknown exits and requires a subsequent List to complete while generation remains alive.
Silent Spawn expires at its bound and closes the channel; six Stop requests and three exit waiters must receive the correct shared tree facts.
Ten operations fail on peer death; next registry lookup is generation 2 while the old Tree still fails against generation 1.
contracts: Gone trees answer stop and inventory locally without a further frame.
dependencies: client/channel.rs and client/start::Registry are exercised through synthetic protocol peers.
failures_or_limits: Tests verify host state transitions; they do not execute actual supervisor shutdown.

purpose: Pins configured supervisor path, Unix trust checks and symlink candidate lookup.
behavior: Configuration may change before first startup, same-path retry remains valid after start, and a different late or empty path is InvalidArgument without replacing state.

Unix candidate tests accept an owned directory and binary at 0755 (owner write allowed), reject modes granting group or other write access (binary 0777; directories 0777, 0775 and 01777), and reject missing directories.
Symlinked executable lookup yields both apparent and canonical directories without duplicating a plain executable directory.
contracts: Tests use a private Mutex slot so global process configuration is not changed.
failures_or_limits: No Windows ACL trust test exists here; only configuration assertions are cross-platform.
